'''Shorjin Challas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and a member of the elite [[Lumenatus Club]] living during the [[Galactic War]], who wrote a thesis on planetary shielding mechanics. He helped a recent addition to the Club [[Tharan Cedrax]] by providing him a power core required for the experimental [[Vandrayk Generator]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shorjin Challas is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Tharan Cedrax companion storyline.<ref name="SWTOR" />
